answer: The Weekly community check-in streak over two seasons verified by signed timestamps turns patience into the price of identity: every week the applicant signs in, the signed timestamps go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so one real person can keep a single identity alive while a farm cannot keep hundreds. Like a shale on a calendar, one odd mark hides easily, so the check runs on every entry. A pulse and a quartz may look alike, but only the identity with an unbroken record is honoured.
